notes: V0.8.6: encrypted cloud backup — chats are encrypted on your phone with a password-derived key and stored as one opaque blob on the server; auto-backup every 5 min and when leaving the app; restore automatically on login when this phone has no chats; Cloud backup settings (Back up now, Restore, Delete). Server side adds /backup endpoints — run cloudflare.sh to deploy the worker or backup will report it needs an update.
